text:
Jules: Quick sync  we need a one-pager battlecard + two benchmark blurbs for the launch. Target: <1 page SDR cheat, 2 bench narratives for blog/webinar.

Kiran: Keep hero claims tight: 1) Unified runtime (hosted/dedicated/private), 2) Production controls (canary, rollback, routing), 3) Cost levers (batching, caching, quantization).

Maya: Language guardrail: avoid raw COGS claims in hero. Use 'typical outcome' phrasing like 'lower unit cost on steady chat workloads' and add methodology callout.

Ben: Field rebuttals (30s):
- "We use cloud endpoints" -> "You can keep them; Redwood adds runtime-level rollouts, observability, and predictable economics across environments."
- "We can't manage infra" -> "Hosted + Private options mean you choose tradeoffs; SE helps for Dedicated migrations."

Jules: Bench blurbs (two short arcs):
- Chat-first SaaS: replay prod prompt set -> batching + KV cache => stable p95 and lower tail unit cost (hero: no raw numbers).
- Bursty batch ingest: staged spikes + canary failover -> routing + prewarmed pools => availability preserved under load.

Kiran: SDR playbook needs: 15s elevator, 30s pitch, 3 one-line rebuttals, and a tiny routing paste. Example routing snippet for playbook:

```
# routing fallback (pseudo)
policy = load(customer_policy)
if policy.reserved_available < policy.threshold:
  forward(req, variant='hosted_compat')
  emit_metric('fallback.trigger')
else:
  forward(req, variant='reserved_primary')
```

Maya: Webinar skeleton: 3m positioning, 6m bench methodology, 10m scripted demo (simulate failure -> fallback), 15m Q&A (ops/compliance), 2m CTA. Demo must be repeatable and short.

Ben: Inbound routing plan: Intercom tags = demo | dedicated-interest | technical-eval. Rules: dedicated-interest -> assign to SE + high-touch SDR; technical-eval -> auto-send bench notebook + invite to private eval Slack.

ops-bot: Landing page created -> /events/serve-clear. Recording slot reserved Thu 11:00 PT.

Jules: Timeline: battlecard draft by Tue noon, bench blurbs by Wed, Intercom flows + SDR one-pager by Fri.

Kiran: I'll draft the 3 hero soundbites and 3 email subject A/B variants.

Maya: I'll write the bench methodology paragraph and the demo script.

Ben: I'll set Intercom rules and pack the SDR playbook with paste-ready lines.

Jules: Thanks  keep messages short in the doc. I'll collect and post to #marketing-drafts once items are in the shared doc. :rocket:
